title: WorkPulse leave.requested v1
description: A leave request was submitted and is pending a decision. Identifiers, type code and inclusive dates only — the free-text reason is PII and never leaves the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

leave_type_code.description: Seeded leave type code; `unpaid` does not touch a balance.

start_date.description: First day of the leave range (inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

end_date.description: Last day of the leave range (inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD`).
